nodes.label: Phase 4 Live Test Guide (Neon + Testnet)
nodes.rationale: Walks through Phase 4 with the Nest backend, a Neon development branch, Postman, and Stellar testnet. Use testnet accounts only. Never put production wallet keys or a production database URL in this setup. Record a Phase 4 row in the migration plan only after the checks actually pass.

nodes.label: Neon PostgreSQL
nodes.rationale: Use a development-branch direct connection string with sslmode=require as DATABASE_URL. Do not run prisma migrate reset; it deletes database data. Add a PHPC token row and sender and receiver accounts with unique six-character Base62 short IDs.

nodes.label: Redis
nodes.rationale: Redis is separate from Neon and is used for queues and locks. REDIS_URL is the provider TLS URL, often rediss://, and is required for queue testing. It is not the Neon DATABASE_URL.

nodes.label: Stellar testnet
nodes.rationale: Use soroban-testnet.stellar.org, horizon-testnet.stellar.org, and the Test SDF Network passphrase. Testnet keypairs are required for sender, receiver, relayer, and registrar.

nodes.label: Postman
nodes.source_location: 6. Signed deposit, withdraw, and transfer requests
nodes.rationale: Postman sends the HTTP requests but does not create Ed25519 signatures. Paste only a Base64 signature from the sender wallet or a trusted signing helper. Never paste a secret key or a connection string into Postman.

nodes.label: Pijin contract
nodes.rationale: Deployed testnet contract identified by CONTRACT_ID. Useful reads are get_registrar, get_offline_key, get_recipient, and get_vault. Local cargo test does not touch Neon or testnet.

nodes.label: PHPC
nodes.rationale: Sender and receiver need PHPC test funds and a PHPC trustline. 10000000 stroops equals 1 PHPC when the token has seven decimal places. The active Token row must use the PHPC SAC contract id.

nodes.label: Friendbot
nodes.rationale: Friendbot funds XLM only. It does not provide PHPC.

nodes.label: register_gateway
nodes.rationale: Before online settlement the relayer must be funded with testnet XLM and whitelisted on-chain with register_gateway by the contract admin. An unregistered relayer makes spend_offline fail with contract error #9.

nodes.label: set_registrar
nodes.rationale: The on-chain registrar must equal REGISTRAR_PUBLIC_KEY. If none is set, the contract admin calls set_registrar first.

nodes.label: SEP-10
nodes.source_location: 7. SEP-10 login, offline key, and recipient registry
nodes.rationale: GET /api/v2/auth returns a challenge transaction. POST /api/v2/auth with the signed challenge returns a JWT. Offline-key enroll returns rotation_required and an XDR; PATCH after submission expects status synced, and PATCH before submission returns 409. Recipient registry returns registered, then already_registered.

nodes.label: Ed25519 bearer signature
nodes.source_location: 6. Signed deposit, withdraw, and transfer requests
nodes.rationale: Deposit, withdraw, and online transfer require Authorization Bearer set to a Base64 Ed25519 signature. Deposit signs deposit:sender:amount, withdraw signs withdraw:sender:amount, and online transfer signs transfer:v2:online:token:sender:recipient:amount. Omitting clientProtocol 2 returns HTTP 426 ONLINE_TRANSFER_PROTOCOL_REQUIRED. A missing header is 401.

nodes.label: /api/v2
nodes.rationale: The legacy service serves /api and the Nest backend serves /api/v2. Compare status and JSON on safe requests to https://pijin-api.vercel.app and http://localhost:3001. Do not repeat mutating requests against legacy production with real accounts or secrets.

nodes.label: /api/v2/v2 paths
nodes.source_location: 6. Signed deposit, withdraw, and transfer requests
nodes.rationale: Sections 6 and 7 write deposit, withdraw, transfer, auth, offline-key, recipient-registry, and transfer confirm under /api/v2/v2. Section 5 and section 10 say the Nest routes are /api/v2. The doubled prefix is not reconciled in the guide.

nodes.label: GET /api/v2/health
nodes.source_location: 4. Start the backend and check health
nodes.rationale: Expect HTTP 200 and healthy database, Redis, and Soroban RPC checks before any engine call. The dev server is started with npm run start:dev --workspace=backend on port 3001.

nodes.label: POST /api/v2/sms/dispatch
nodes.source_location: 9. Settlement test: use the inbound path
nodes.rationale: Sends an outbound SMS through TextBee. It does not enqueue a settlement.

nodes.label: POST /api/v2/sms/webhook
nodes.source_location: 9. Settlement test: use the inbound path
nodes.rationale: An incoming TextBee message hits this route, which validates the signed webhook and voucher, then enqueues the settlement. The mobile app does not create offline vouchers, so a trusted voucher generator is required before idempotency, replay, and crash-recovery checks.

nodes.label: engine-settlement queue
nodes.source_location: 9. Settlement test: use the inbound path
nodes.rationale: With QUEUE_ENABLED=true, a valid inbound voucher should be saved in Neon as PENDING with transaction hash and signed XDR before broadcast, then become SETTLED. The sender vault falls by the amount plus toll and the receiver token balance rises.
